name: Voyage
note: Airline SkyMiles home screen — boarding-pass hero + miles meter + trip list.
thesis: A calm consumer airline app rendered as a centered, airy single column on a pale sky-tinted field: a full-bleed gradient boarding-pass hero (deep ocean → sky), a miles-to-Platinum meter, a twelve-month flight-activity bar chart, and an upcoming-trips list. Big extra-bold IATA numerals and a mono annotation layer (flight/gate/seat, miles balance, tier scale) carry the boarding-pass fiction; one sky accent ramp (sky-700 → sky-400) colors every meter, peak bar, and gradient chip. Generous whitespace, rounded corners throughout, no app chrome.

tokens.bg: #EEF4FA pale sky page; #FFFFFF cards; a #0C4A6E→#0EA5E9 linear-gradient boarding-pass hero (white ink)
tokens.fg: #12283D deep ink primary / #5A748C secondary / #8DA3B8 muted (tier scale, chevrons); on the gradient hero: #fff with rgba(255,255,255,.7–.8) for eyebrow + subtitles
tokens.accent: #0369A1 sky-700 (miles balance, peak bars, brand chip, Add-trip, selected row) + #38BDF8 sky-400 (gradient stop, default bars, meter fill end); status pills add one emerald #0F9D58 on #E3F3EC for Confirmed
tokens.fontDisplay: var(--font-sans) (Geist) — 40px/800 IATA codes, 700 city/panel headings, 15px semibold card titles
tokens.fontMono: var(--font-mono) (Geist Mono) — the annotation layer: boarding-pass detail values (DL 1428 / C7 / 14A / 3:50p), the 84,210 miles balance, the Gold / Platinum·100k scale, the colophon
tokens.radius: 22px on the boarding-pass hero, 18px on cards + the trips panel, 13px flag tiles, 999px pill badges, 5px meter track/fill, 4px rounded bar caps
tokens.border: 1px #D6E3EF card hairline; #EAF0F6 panel-head divider; #F0F4F8 trip-row dividers; the root wears an inset 1px #D6E3EF ring; the boarding pass carries a 1px dashed rgba(255,255,255,.3) Separator
tokens.motion: one keyframe — an 8px rise+fade entrance staggered across the hero (0ms) / cards (60ms) / panel (120ms); plus 140ms color/opacity micro-transitions on nav links, the Add-trip hover, and trip-row hover/select/dim. All killed under prefers-reduced-motion.

layout: No sidebar, no persistent chrome — a centered single column capped at 1080px with 22–24px page padding on a pale sky field, the whole surface pulled full-bleed (margin:-1px) and ring-framed inside the demo frame. A light transparent topbar (gradient 'V' chip + Voyage wordmark left; Trips/Explore/Miles nav + circular 'RW' avatar right) sits over a full-width gradient boarding-pass hero, then a 1fr/1fr card row (SkyMiles meter + 2026-travel chart), then a full-width upcoming-trips list card, then a mono colophon. Airy density: big numerals, lots of whitespace, rounded corners throughout; the two-up grid stacks under 720px.

sections.name: Topbar

contentArchetype: A single traveler's airline / miles home screen (traveler 'RW'): the next flight as a live boarding pass (MKE Milwaukee 4:20p → SFO San Francisco 6:55p, Delta DL 1428, Gate C7, Seat 14A, boards in 2h 40m), a SkyMiles balance of 84,210 at Gold with 15,790 to Platinum (84% of 100k), a year of flight activity (14 trips · 38,400 mi flown across twelve months with mid-year peaks), and four upcoming trips (San Francisco / Tokyo / Denver / Lisbon) each with a flag tile, dates·nights, and a Confirmed/Booked/Planning status. Terse, friendly, numbers-forward — a loyalty app you glance at before you fly.
remix: Steal the three moves: (1) a full-width gradient 'pass/ticket' hero with big extra-bold codes + a mono detail strip split by a dashed Separator — reads as a boarding pass, event ticket, receipt, or order confirmation; (2) one accent RAMP (sky-700 → sky-400) reused everywhere — gradient chip, meter fill, and per-bar chart color (a two-tone default/peak encoding) — so the palette stays coherent with zero extra hues; (3) an airy centered consumer layout (no sidebar) that pairs a metric meter with a small EChart and a status-pill list. Swap the sky gradient + IATA codes and it becomes any loyalty/wallet/subscription home: a hotel-points app, a transit pass, a gym membership, a rideshare wallet. Blends well with Bento (retile the hero + two cards + list into asymmetric tiles) or a darker Product idiom (drop the gradient onto slate, keep the ramp).
